about: Generated by tools/map_layout.mjs from map/world/S2.json; never edit. Metres in the section frame: X east (out of the city in S5), D north, H up. Entities keep their map IDs; figures and trees also carry their slug as id for people.json.

assumptions: East-west and height 77 px per metre, depth 51.25 px of v per metre, as every section (S5). Things up the silk are painted smaller (questions: the diminution); positions only come from the map (BUILDING.md rule 5).

dx drifts along S2 by the knots above: from S3's 30.4 at the seam to 43.1 by the trackers, 48.3 at the eatery, 46.6 at 沿河雅座, then turns through 0 near 王家纸马铺 (u ~26960) to -51.6 on the east wharf, linear between and constant beyond. The drift and the turn are the painter's (the lead's note for S3/S2: keep the seam knot and add the measured knots). S1 starts from -51.6 at u 29050.
Painted figure size is not a scale (wharf figures 133-148 px at v 700-900, 1.7-1.9 m at 77 px/m; the north-bank strip's 54-95 px). Place by foot point.

The bank tops on both sides of the river are at street level (ground, H 0); the banks' shore lines stand on the water (support_by). Things painted on the wash slope between them (`bank slope`) are taken half way down, H -0.35 (assumed).

Boat decks and roofs are the water plus the painted rise from the waterline to the deck straight above it (two stroke points each, the river agents' readings unless said); the high-sided boats are drawn with 150-210 px of side, so their decks come out 2-2.7 m above the water (questions).

datum.about: where the route crosses the seam with S3 (u 20500): S2.road.main's centre-line point 0, exactly S3.road.main's last centre point (20500, 258, est; read from map/strokes/S3.json by merge_fixes.mjs on every run). Station +179.21 there, S3's route station at that point (sections/rainbow_bridge/layout.json), so stations run on.

trees.what: A thick slanting dark stroke with a fork or crossbar at its top, standing in front of the far building at the top of the silk: a small bare tree, or a post with a bracket (a well sweep's post?).
A second dark vertical trunk from the silk's top edge, east of the first, ending in a rounded dark mass at its foot (a shrub or the trunk's swollen base).
Pollarded willow whose trunk is hidden behind the long thatched shed: only its knobbed head shows above the roof ridge, with a dense spray of long straight new whips radiating up and out like a fan.
A dark vertical trunk running down from the silk's top edge behind the far buildings north-east of the 望火楼; its crown is above the silk.
A second fan of straight willow whips west of the first, radiating from a point at the roof's back slope: a second pollarded willow behind the long shed, or the west half of the same tree.

Tall deciduous tree (elm-like) with a straight dark trunk standing just west of the 望火楼's stair, behind the rear shed's roof; crooked branches spread west over the leaf clusters and east over the stair, cut by the silk's top edge; early leafing.

Bare deciduous tree (elm-like) with a single twisted trunk rising behind the middle shed and a wide crown of crooked branches tipped with small dark leaf tufts, spreading west over the two-storey building's gable to the willow and east toward the fire tower; early spring.

Willow standing behind the long north shed: its trunk (one thick trunk or two stems) rises above the shed's roof and its fine hanging whips fill the silk's top edge over the roof; early spring, no leaf masses.

Two straight, dark, nearly parallel stems rising from behind the east end of the long tiled roof at the top of the silk to the silk's top edge, about 15 px apart; their crown is above the silk and their foot behind the building: a small tree (or a forked trunk) standing behind the roof, west of the willow S2.tree.willow_27925.

Huge old willow: a thick, twisted, knotted trunk rises from the foot of the bank at the jetty's west end and leans up and north-west for about 250 px of silk to a massive knobbed, pollarded head lying almost level at u 26800-27050 (v 515-650). From the knobs a fan of long thin whips spreads in every direction: west over the moored boat's bow, up to the street in front of 王家纸马铺 (v about 195) and east over the sheds' roofs. Bare whips drawn as fine lines without leaf masses (early spring); one trunk.

Old pollarded willow standing on the far street at the top edge, with a dark knobbed head (u 26600-26665, v 50-130) on two short legs, and bare, leafless whips spraying up to the silk's top edge and out to both sides (early spring).

A continuous low row of small leafy shrubs and weeds along the foot of the plain south wall of the long house, from the weed clump at the west corner east to the house's east corner post, about knee high against the wall.

A clump of tall grass or weed stems arching east, with a low leafy mass at its foot, growing at the foot of the house wall just east of the gate, against the house's west corner post; the west end of the strip of shrubs along the wall.

A dark, densely hatched mass about 40 px wide and 95 px tall standing at the west end of the house, just east of the willow's eastern leg and below the east end of the bamboo fence: read as a dense low shrub against the wall; it may instead be a woven or lattice screen at the house's corner.

Huge old pollarded willow whose gnarled, knobbed trunk is split into two legs like an inverted V: a western leg (foot about (22225, 290)) and a thicker eastern leg (foot about (22345, 318)) that twist up into one knobbed head at about (22180-22330, 50-150); from the head long thin whips spray in every direction, west over the trackers to about u 21870 and east over the bamboo fence and the house roof to about u 22520, cut off by the silk's top edge. Whips drawn as fine lines without leaf masses (early spring).
A small branching shrub or bush at the west end of the south-bank mound's crest, where the crest's dark band of low growth begins.

Huge old pollarded willow on the south bank: a massive, knobbed, hollow-looking trunk about 150-200 px wide rising from just above the south-bank roofs and leaning north; at about v 960-1000 it forks into a tall upright stem that carries the crown's top and a heavy eastern limb; long thin whips without leaf masses (early spring) droop from both, the eastern ones sweeping far out over the water to about u 22090. Single trunk.

A bare tree (a small pollard, or a bare deciduous tree) on the south bank east of the great dark-trunked tree: a fan of long, thin, straight bare stems rising from a point just above the south-bank hall's west hip and spreading up and east over the water among the dark tree's shoots.

Pollarded willow on the north bank just east of the big one, in front of a slatted wattle fence: a twisted trunk leaning north-east up the silk that forks into two knobbed heads, each sprouting bare whips that reach the silk's top edge. Leafless spring whips.

Old pollarded willow on the north bank at the silk's top edge: a dark, gnarled trunk with a knobbed head about 80 px below the edge, from which long bare whips radiate in every direction, the western ones drooping toward the moored boats. Single trunk, standing nearly upright with a slight lean east; leafless spring whips.

Massive old tree on the south bank, the darkest thing at the bottom of the silk: a thick, gnarled, knotty trunk rising from the silk's bottom edge to a knobbed head at about v 1300, with one pale, straight limb leaning far up-west and a fan of long, thin, bare straight shoots rising from the head into the middle of the silk over the water. Read as a pollarded old willow in spring (bare whips); could also be a bare elm-like tree.

S2.veh.boat_bottom_28395.name: smaller boat at the bottom edge, rafted to the second grain boat
S2.veh.boat_bottom_28395.what: A smaller planked boat lying south of the second grain boat at the silk's bottom edge, bow west under the willow whips: a plain hull with strakes and round bitts or cleats along the gunwale (u 28450-28600), a small upright structure on deck at u 28637-28668, an upswept stern (28738, 1578) over a planked transom gallery (u 28680-28812, v 1656-1725), and a big rudder: a stock with a drum-shaped head and ropes (u 28792-28853, v 1576-1676) and a battened blade reaching down and aft to (28955, 1768). A ladder leans from its deck (28575, 1545) up to the second grain boat's after deck (28500, 1420). No cargo or crew read.

S2.veh.boat_grain_28095.name: second grain boat (万石船) under the willows
S2.veh.boat_grain_28095.what: A second laden grain boat moored east of the first, bow to bow-stern with it, bow west: a woven-mat hood with a coiled mat on its top over the bow (u 28015-28290, v 1160-1240), a cross beam and posts below it, the dark raked stem descending to the water; the hull and its mat-covered cargo run east under the willow whips; on the after deck (u 28480-28700, v 1280-1430) a pile of heavy coiled cables and a long bundle with two short dark uprights (bitts, or one man and his raised arm: see the low-confidence figure S2.fig.boatman_coils_28543) and a small windlass frame; the stern is hidden behind the massive willow's knobbed head. A ladder runs from its after deck down to the bottom boat (S2.veh.boat_bottom_28395); its mooring line goes to t11's post with a coiled rope at the bank's foot (S2.prop.mooring_post_rope_28272).

S2.veh.boat_grain_27285.name: grain boat (万石船) with the gangplank
S2.veh.boat_grain_27285.what: A big, broad, deep-laden grain boat moored with its rounded bow to the north-west against the bank and its stern toward the viewer: at the bow two overlapping woven-mat roofs (u 27280-27750, v 1000-1110) over a small deckhouse with windows and posts (u 27560-27750); a long spar lying fore-and-aft along the deck (u 27490-27810, v 1128-1147: the lowered mast or a windlass beam); planked hatch covers (u 27305-27500, v 1195-1295) and the cargo under nets of crossing ropes amidships; a high transom stern with an arched gallery roof (u 27760-28010, v 1155-1220), a tiller bar (v 1265-1280) and a big rudder hanging from its centre, the blade reaching (28086, 1593). A cleated gangplank runs from its north gunwale near the stern (27795, 1145) up the bank to (28023, 1050) (nobody on it), and two mooring lines run from the gunwale beside it up to t10's rope coil and stake on the bank top (S2.prop.coiled_rope_27873, S2.prop.mooring_stake_27902). Moored stern to bow with the second grain boat (S2.veh.boat_grain_28095).

S2.veh.cart_round_top_26035.name: round-topped cart (or stall under a round canopy) on the far street
S2.veh.cart_round_top_26035.what: A large round-topped thing on a low frame on the far street: read as a parked cart under a round arched cover or carrying a huge round load, its bed (v 90-102) on props at u ≈ 25930 and 25990, its east end at the feeding horse. Faint.

S2.veh.boat_mat_cabin_25980.name: big cabin boat with mat roofs moored by the warehouse
S2.veh.boat_mat_cabin_25980.what: A big timber boat moored along the north bank west of the great willow, bow west: a deep planked hull with nail rows; a gable-roofed fore cabin (u 26040-26150) and a long flat-roofed cabin with plank walls and doors behind it to u ~26530, a ladder leaning against the cabin side from the deck to the roof (26255, 840)-(26200, 720), a row of round coiled bundles (rolled mats or rope coils; the restyle draws tied netted baskets) along a woven-mat cover behind the roof (v 650-700), and a long pole lying along the roof (u 26330-26565, v ~645: a spare spar or punting pole); aft, a barrel-vaulted woven-mat hood (u 26490-26700, v 610-720) with three big round bundles, an open arched mat hood over the after deck (u 26700-26800) with a man in its mouth, a raised stern gallery with a lattice rail and an overhanging stern (tip (26845, 707)); under the stern a big rudder on a stock with a drum-shaped head, its lattice blade reaching down and aft into the water. A post with a round head stands on deck at (26365, 725). No mooring line or sweep is drawn. Its bow is hidden behind the stern and rudder of river_m's boat moored just west of it (u 25150-26050).

S2.veh.barrow_crates_25598.name: barrow or handcart with two lattice crates
S2.veh.barrow_crates_25598.what: Small barrow or handcart on the far street carrying two lattice crates, one low at its west end (u 25528-25565, v 76-100) and one higher at its east end (u 25568-25598, v 36-73), the shafts running up to the man at its east end; no wheel is visible.

S2.veh.boat_moored_mat_canopy_25145.name: boat with a mat canopy and mat cabin, moored before the halls
S2.veh.boat_moored_mat_canopy_25145.what: A big plank-built river boat moored along the bank in front of the 沿河雅座 halls, bow west: at the bow a pair of scroll-ended bitt beams (25165-25255, v 660-690) with coiled ropes, its mooring rope running up the bank to t6's post S2.prop.mooring_post_25207; a dark plank hatch cover over the fore hold (25200-25400, v 715-780); a broad dark arched mat canopy on posts over the foredeck (25400-25610, v 528-620) sheltering a lidded jar, a bowl and other gear; a long rounded mat cabin roof (25610-25880, v 595-680) with casks and bundles on and behind it, a domed ribbed basket (25890-25920, v 620-650) and a box (25935-25965, v 625-660) at its east end; a raised hatch board on legs amidships (25605-25760, v 740-780) and curved bamboo hoops (awning frames) along the deck; a high stern with a carved post and a big rudder whose blade hangs to (26105, 1065). Crew: a man leaning on the casks, and faint others under the canopy and at the cabin's east end.

S2.veh.mule_cart_24305.name: big two-wheeled cart being loaded
S2.veh.mule_cart_24305.what: Big two-wheeled cart with a long open bed (spoked wheels about the height of a man's chest), standing on the street facing west with its team of two mules hitched in front by long traces. Its load: a large flat bundle covered by a woven mat (a lattice of small cross marks), tilted up at the west end, over a dark hatched heap (straw or sacks). The bed's rails run on past its rear to u ≈ 24518 and a prop stick stands under the rear. A man stands on the bed's front handling the load; a saddled horse (t6's) stands behind its rear.

S2.veh.boat_cargo_hooded_bow_23715.name: high-sided cargo boat with a hooded bow, moored along the north bank
S2.veh.boat_cargo_hooded_bow_23715.what: A very long, high-sided boat lying along the north bank, bow west, close beside 逆水行舟 to its south and end to end with 豪华客船 to its west: at the bow (u 23700-23900) a curved arched beam over a dark mat hood, a deck post and a spoked windlass; on deck a flat board platform on legs and big round coils of rope or baskets (23940-24090, v 635-725) and a short ladder leaning from the deck up to the bank (top at (24045, 505)); amidships a flat mat-roofed deckhouse open at the sides (roof u 24275-24583, v 496-530) with a second arched beam and a dark mat hood at its east end (24425-24600, v 586-730); east of it a spoked wheel or windlass on a post (24640-24740, v 523-590); aft a huge rounded mat cover over the cargo, topped with a woven round basket (24775-25137, v 542-667); a high curved stern with a carved post and the rudder stock at u ~25100-25130. A coil or round fender hangs on its south side at (24380, 840), and at the bow a long rope-wrapped fender (or bundle) hangs on a line over its south side, between it and 逆水行舟's foredeck (u 23735-23768, v 745-872). No mast. Its many strakes with rivet rows show it riding high (unladen). Crew: a man at the bow (the spoked windlass beside him is unmanned), one or two men at the aft windlass, two crouching on deck, two in the deckhouse and a man poling at the gunwale.

S2.veh.boat_towed_mast_23632.name: 逆水行舟: the big passenger-cargo boat with a mast, towed upstream
S2.veh.boat_towed_mast_23632.what: A long, deep river boat lying in mid-river south of the cargo boat, bow west, being towed upstream: a single mast stepped amidships in a braced tabernacle on the cabin roof at u ~24190, its top at (24183, 302), with a fan of about fifteen stays and lines to both ends of the deck; the tow rope is made fast to the mast at (24188, 375) and runs about 2350 px west over the cargo boat's bow, the bank and the water to the five trackers (t2: S2.grp.boat_towed_mast_23632; the rope's far end is in the lead tracker S2.fig.tracker_lead_21867's hands at (21832, 197)); a short bar is lashed across the rope at (23945, 435-472). A long plank-walled cabin with lattice windows and a door runs the whole length under a low mat roof (cabin walls v ~1030-1140); the bow at the west end has a dark arched mat hood over a low foredeck, a carved stem post and two boat-hooks lying crossed over the stem; the stern at the east end rises over a big rudder whose blade trails at the waterline (24965-25185, v 1160-1220), under a mat awning with a big coil of bamboo rope (24900-25000, v 840-930) and two light boards standing under it, a tall one at u 24732-24789 (v 869-979) and a shorter one just west of the coil at u 24866-24902 (v 920-975); a long dark mat-hatched blade projects east from the stern at deck level to (25285, 1010) (a sweep 橹 shipped aft, or the stern awning's eave). Coiled ropes and bundles on the roof. Crew: a bowman under the hood, a man fending off 豪华客船's stern with a pole, a robed man on the foredeck, three or four men on the roof (one kneeling and hauling a line at the mast), a passenger at a window (perhaps two) and a man at the stern cabin's door. Not moored: it passes the moored cargo boat on its south side, close alongside.

S2.veh.boat_passenger_22545.name: 豪华客船, the long passenger boat
S2.veh.boat_passenger_22545.what: A very long passenger boat moored along the north bank below the terrace, bow west: at the bow a curved post rising from the stem to a netted knob (a lantern cage or fender basket) and a beam with lashings projecting west at deck level; an open fore canopy with a dark mat roof on four posts (u 22465-22560), then a cabin with mat-curtained walls (22580-22700), a long cabin with lattice windows, panelled sills and a door (22700-23300) with a chair or bench back (u 22960-23020, v 720-770) and a table with things on it (u 23090-23140, v 730-770) seen through its openings, an open bay with two passengers (23300-23440), and an after cabin with hanging mat blinds under a dark mat roof (23440-23700) carrying on top a deck with a windlass (23360-23430) and a small arched mat shelter (23490-23640); a narrow side walkway runs outside the cabins. Cargo lies on the roof: coiled ropes, a drum, round baskets and bales, a rolled mat and a big round basket. A ladder leans from the side walkway to the roof at u 23240-23310. A mooring rope runs from S2.prop.mooring_post_23126 to its roof rail. No mast is up; no sweep or rudder shows (the stern is hidden).

S2.veh.boat_mat_roof_22290.name: mat-roofed boat moored along the south spit
S2.veh.boat_mat_roof_22290.what: A long boat moored along the low south spit, bow west: a long arched mat roof on posts over its west two thirds (u 22290-22780), with cloths or curtains hanging under its west end; a raked pole (a lowered mast or a stowed quant) leans west from the roof's west post with a cloth (a furled sail?) hanging from it; an open after deck and, at the east end, an overhanging stern frame of lashed beams with a rudder whose stock stands at u ~22885 and whose blade lies along the waterline to u ~23050. A rope runs from its side down to the spit. On the deck under the roof's middle lie a flat woven object (a straw sandal, a folded mat or a basket lid; u 22440-22495, v 1592-1615) and a small staved tub (u 22505-22535, v 1580-1615). A man bends over the near gunwale pouring a bucket into the river.

S2.veh.boat_small_bow_22158.name: small boat's bow at the silk's edge
S2.veh.boat_small_bow_22158.what: Only the bow of a small boat shows, coming in from below the silk's bottom edge beside the south bank's flat edge: a pointed dark-hatched bow with a short post and the curve of its near gunwale; the rest of the hull runs off the silk to the south-west. Nobody is seen in it.

S2.veh.boat_sweep_22000.name: boat with six men at its great stern sweep
S2.veh.boat_sweep_22000.what: A boat in midstream heading west (upstream), its hull running west under the great willow's whips: a planked after deck where six men crowd along the loom of a great sweep (大橹); a stern frame of crossbeams lashed together overhangs the stern eastward to about u 22420, the loom crossing it at a pivot; the sweep's long shaft runs on east-south-east into the water and ends in a broad flat blade with an upturned tip at about u 22945. The stern's side carries a decorated oval panel with two eye-like marks.

S2.veh.boat_open_21968.name: open boat tied to the south bank's mound
S2.veh.boat_open_21968.what: A small open boat with thwarts and floor boards, no cabin, lying at the foot of the south bank's mound; its squared west end is tied by a twisted rope to the mound's face, and small knobs or bollards stand on its far gunwale. A man sits in it, and a second shape crouches at its east end.

S2.veh.boat_covered_21205.name: small covered boat off the south bank (bow east)
S2.veh.boat_covered_21205.what: A small boat lying off the south bank under the great willow's whips, with a mat canopy on four thin posts over most of its length (u 20880-21240, v 1060-1110; gabled at its east end) and a squared, raised bow board at the east end (u 21190-21215, v 1145-1200); a man sits under the canopy beside a small upright figure or tall vase, and a round basket lies on the deck at the west (u 20985-21010, v 1185-1205). No mast, oars or sweep are painted; people on the bank in front of it (t1's group) reach or hold something up toward it.

S2.veh.boat_big_cabin_21120.name: big cabin boat moored along the north bank (bow west, rudder east)
S2.veh.boat_big_cabin_21120.what: A big river boat moored along the north bank in front of the shops, bow to the west-north-west: a curved stem head with a round windlass hub at the bow (u 21110-21190, v 155-210) and a long oar or pole slanting down from the bow into the water (to about (21265, 318)); a flat mat awning on posts (u 21220-21350, v 160-200) over a row of six coiled ropes hanging along the far gunwale (u 21225-21350, v 195-225); a short upright post on deck (u ~21362, v 150-200); a low cabin with a window (u 21290-21400, v 240-300) where a man sits; a big round-arched cabin frame (u 21400-21500, v 200-300) and a deckhouse with a sloping mat roof (u 21430-21660, v 160-280); a high stern with a gabled rudder house (u 21650-21800, v 170-260) and a big rudder hung over the stern, its blade in the water (u 21650-21780, v 345-420). The hull is planked with rows of nails and bellies down to v ~388 under the deckhouse. No mast or sail. Three crew are painted.

S2.veh.boat_skiff_21080.name: open skiff among the south willow's whips
S2.veh.boat_skiff_21080.what: A small open boat (skiff) lying diagonally under the great south-bank willow's whips, its pointed west end at about (21068, 835) and its hull running east-south-east behind the willow's lower branches and trunk: planked sides (the near gunwale from (21090, 880) to (21290, 950)) and thwarts or gear inside (u 21140-21200, v 840-895). No one aboard, no mast or oars.

S2.veh.boat_mat_cargo_21055.name: long cargo boat with mat roofs, moored along the north bank (bow east)
S2.veh.boat_mat_cargo_21055.what: A long, low cargo boat moored along the north bank, its west end hidden behind the stern of S3's big boat at the bridge: a long dark arched mat roof over its west part (u ~20380-20620, v 280-330); amidships a low mat cover over the cargo, two big round woven baskets or mat-wrapped bales (u 20690-20800, v 330-420) and a coil of rope on deck (u ~20800-20870, v 300-340) from which its mooring rope runs up to the foot of the second top willow (S2.tree.willow_top_20668, t1's) at about (20660, 205); a small cabin at the east end with a planked doorway and a sloping mat roof (u 20830-21000, v 300-425), a lattice rail at u 20600-20680, and a big lidded water jar on the foredeck (u 20970-21020, v 365-410). No mast, sweep or oars are painted. Six crew: a pole man and two men leaning west toward S3's big boat, a man on the roof stretching his arm toward it, and two men at the east cabin.

S2.veh.boat_mat_shelter_20805.name: low boat with mat roofs, moored between the cargo boat and the bank
S2.veh.boat_mat_shelter_20805.what: A low boat moored close in to the north bank, north of the cargo boat and end to end with the big cabin boat's bow: a woven mat roof over its west half (u 20800-20990, v 190-245) with a big coil of rope (or a round coiled mat) lying on it (u 20860-20990, v 190-235); east of it a flat roof with a slatted eave (u 20960-21100, v 230-290) and a higher woven mat roof (u 21000-21115, v 150-210), with jars or boxes on deck under it (u 21020-21080, v 215-240). Hull planking shows only at the west end (u 20800-20900, v 255-300). No crew, mast or sweep is painted.
